# Optional historical comparison engine

`r3_sparse.py` is retained byte-for-byte from the previous candidate. Its SHA-256
is checked by `routing.legacy_bridge` before execution. The bridge imports NumPy;
the active default library, CLI and release checks do not require NumPy.

This is a restricted comparator with separate admission/numerical limitations,
not the default planner or the complete historical road-research architecture.
The refactor makes no changes to its source or the applicable original terms.
